title: Husbandry Care for Mice
author: K.C. Kent Lloyd
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8nqhvdw

steps.title: Perform Daily Husbandry Tasks
steps.instruction: Complete the following tasks every day (365 days a year), wearing minimum PPE consisting of a laboratory coat and gloves.

substeps.instruction: Provide nutritionally adequate ad libitum feed (uncontaminated and fresh), unless otherwise approved in the animal care and use Protocol.
Ensure rodent chow is used within 6 months of the milling date, unless manufacturer guidelines specify otherwise.
Ensure feed with added Vitamin C is used within 3 months of milling date (or 6 months if microencapsulated).
Provide sufficient potable water.
Observe each animal and check for health concerns.
Record sick or dead animals using the Veterinary Health Check Request per MBPVIV-40-102.
Change heavily soiled or flooded cages immediately upon discovery.
Keep the room clean and organized.
Record minimum and maximum temperatures (ideal range: 64-79°F).
Check and update cage cards daily.
Initial and date the Animal Room Monitoring Sheet, recording room temperature, number of animals, sick/dead animals, and completed care tasks.

steps.title: Perform Weekly Husbandry Tasks
steps.instruction: Complete the following tasks weekly, referring to MBPVIV-31-101 for cage changing procedures.

substeps.instruction: Top off food.
Provide clean water/bottles at least with every cage change.
Wipe down racks.
Check cages.

steps.title: Perform Biweekly Husbandry Tasks
steps.instruction: Complete the following tasks at least every 14 days.

substeps.instruction: Change cages.
Clean and/or change environmental enrichment.

steps.title: Perform Monthly Husbandry Tasks
steps.instruction: Complete the following tasks at least once every 30 days.

substeps.instruction: Clean or change hood filters as needed.

steps.title: Perform Periodic Equipment Maintenance
steps.instruction: Disinfect and replace specific caging components.

substeps.instruction: Disinfect waste barrels and lids.
Change lids, feeders, and duplex dividers.

steps.title: Perform Quarterly Husbandry Tasks
steps.instruction: Complete the following tasks at least once every 180 days.

substeps.instruction: Disinfect the animal room, including walls, floors, and ceilings.
Disinfect feed barrels and lids, and replace the feed liner.
Submit sentinels.
